author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
(May be changed to CTW)



Initial release 10 months ago on Overcast Network A map based off a hyperscale stream. It's pretty big, and the team sizes are 52v52 being red vs. cyan. The TNT is located in the light gray balloon, and I added it because it's a decent size for it imo. There is a redstone building as well including everything you need. Oh, and the monuments are in the red and gray balloons. They have a "marker" under them made out of glass and slabs. I hope this isn't that bad of a map...

Download
Images
YAML

Spawnkit:
- Leather Helmet
- Iron Sword
- Bow, Infinity I
- Diamond Pickaxe
- Stone Axe
- Golden Apple
- 64 Birch Logs
- 16 Steak

- Speed II potion

Teams:
Red vs. Cyan
Red Team + Cyan Team
52v52

Misc. Info:
- You cannot break the spawns
- TNT does not damage teammates

replies.body: I like the look of the map, I just feel like Avicus just doesn't have a large enough fan base to support a 104 player game tbh. But it would help free up the player count from other nebula matches going on.
